name: pkg-summary-cwm-sol
description: Verifies if commited and active packages are same. If there is a mismatch, then a "warning" status is returned with the mismatched package. If the execution fails then the status would be returned as "failed", else it would be "success".

definition.name: pkg-summary-cwm-sol

dataConditions.name: check-lintd
dataConditions.condition: ${ (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco 8000 Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 540L Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 5700 Series Routers") }

dataConditions.name: check-exr
dataConditions.condition: ${ (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 5500 Series") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 540 Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 9000 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco XRv 9000 Series Virtual Routers") }

commands.template:
Value Required Package (\S+)
Value Version (\S+)

Start
  ^-{10,}\s+\-{10,} -> Packages

Packages
  ^${Package}\s+${Version} -> Record

Value Required Package (\S+)
Value Version (\S+)

Start
  ^-{10,}\s+\-{10,} -> Packages

Packages
  ^${Package}\s+${Version} -> Record

expressions.message: Package summary check failed due to package inconsistency.
expressions.condition: ((. | length == 0) or (if .[0] | type == "object" then (.[0].Package as $activate_pkg | .[1].Package as $commit_pkg | $activate_pkg != $commit_pkg) else (if ((.[0] | map(select(.Package != "Active")) | map(.Package)) as $activate_pkgs | (.[1] | map(select(.Package != "Committed")) | map(.Package)) as $commit_pkgs | all($activate_pkgs[]; . as $item | $commit_pkgs | contains([$item])) and all($commit_pkgs[]; . as $item | $activate_pkgs | contains([$item]))) then false else true end) end))

expressions.message: Package summary check failed due to package inconsistency.
expressions.condition: ((. | length ==0) or (if .[0] | type == "object" then (.[0].Package as $activate_pkg | .[1].Package as $commit_pkg | $activate_pkg != $commit_pkg) else (if ((.[0] | map(select(.Package != "Active")) | map(.Package)) as $activate_pkgs | (.[1] | map(select(.Package != "Committed")) | map(.Package)) as $commit_pkgs | all($activate_pkgs[]; . as $item | $commit_pkgs | contains([$item])) and all($commit_pkgs[]; . as $item | $activate_pkgs | contains([$item]))) then false else true end) end))

logs.message: Forming inputs for installed summary check for XR 5k devices

dataConditions.name: output is valid
dataConditions.condition: ${ if .rakutilExecutorData.status=="success" then true else false end}

dataConditions.name: output is not valid
dataConditions.condition: ${ if .rakutilExecutorData.status=="warning" then true else false end}

dataConditions.name: output is not valid
dataConditions.condition: ${ if .rakutilExecutorData.status=="failed" then true else false end}

stateDataFilter.output: ${{status:"warning", message: "package summary check has ended with warnings as activated and committed packages are not same", stash: (if .rakutilExecutorData.stash.output | length == 1 then [.rakutilExecutorData.stash.output[0], .rakutilExecutorData.stash.output[0]] else .rakutilExecutorData.stash.output end)}}
${{status:"failed", message: (if .rakutilExecutorData.message then .rakutilExecutorData.message else "package summary check failed" end)}}

logs.message: Selected product series is not supported

stateDataFilter.output: ${{status:"failed", message: "Selected product series is not supported." }}

definition.description: Verifies if commited and active packages are same. If there is a mismatch, then a "warning" status is returned with the mismatched package. If the execution fails then the status would be returned as "failed", else it would be "success".
